systems.description: Revision-pinned impact, risk, approval, implementation and outcome evidence across source, policy and infrastructure changes.
invariants: Approval pins exactly the reviewed source revision and plan digest
Source change does not imply deployed effect
Unknown or stale source mapping never becomes a confident impact

systems.description: Authorized human and agent action inbox projected from independent systems without taking over their business authority.
invariants: Projection is not approval/task/case authority
All actions revalidate source revision and policy at the issuing service
No cross-tenant or unreadable action metadata leaks

systems.description: Accepted promises, obligations, evidence-backed acceptance and settlement across organizations.
invariants: Closing a task does not satisfy an obligation
Acceptance must refer to exact terms and evidence
Settlement does not follow merely from a fulfillment dispatch

systems.description: Discrepancy detection, investigation, controlled remediation and verified convergence between systems.
invariants: Never infer cross-system atomicity
An uncertain external effect requires re-observation
Correction preserves immutable original observations

systems.description: Constrained cross-organization participation, exchange, decisions and deliverable acceptance.
invariants: Participation does not imply data access
Accept only pinned terms and evidence
Do not expose one participant's private evidence to another

systems.description: Forecast need, reserve constrained capacity, dispatch eligible actors and verify actual work.
invariants: Reservation and consumption are separate facts
Routed assignment requires current eligibility
Job dispatch does not prove business completion

systems.description: Author, pin, distribute and retire authoritative knowledge, procedures, rules and configuration.
invariants: Source definitions and effective values are separately versioned
Published content is revision-pinned
Disposition decision never deletes its own audit evidence

systems.description: Bounded delegated agent actions with exact approval, quota, execution and recovery boundaries.

ports.authority: Gatekeeper PDP and trusted command dispatcher

invariants: Delegation does not grant OAuth scope or bypass current policy
Retries share a stable provider idempotency key
Cancellation request is not proof of rollback

systems.description: Connect quote, subscription, usage, entitlements, ledger, invoices, settlement and internal chargebacks.
invariants: Ledger postings require balanced immutable groups
Usage correction preserves original observations
Payment intent and confirmed settlement are different facts

systems.description: Compare workflow, policy and configuration revisions against controlled synthetic or historical scenarios before rollout.
invariants: Simulation cannot write production state
Historical replay is explicitly bounded by available facts
Simulation result does not automatically approve deployment
